questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve sharply to the right ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always remain at your present speed.
Speed up to avoid congesting traffic.
Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: When you're on a road with two or more lanes, make room for traffic entering from the side. Move to another lane if it's safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.
The bridge ahead is open to one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead is wide enough for only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to meet or pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you that an upcoming bridge is too narrow to safely meet or pass a truck. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means it is not safe to enter from your current direction. You must turn around and take a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead has three or more curves. Slow down and be prepared.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic moving in the same direction are about to combine into one. Be ready to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Slow down without coming to a complete stop.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. Come to a complete stop, check for pedestrians and traffic, and wait for the intersection to clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is bent upward at the elbow, it is a hand signal meaning they plan to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow with black markings. It tells you a stop sign is coming up ahead. Slow down and prepare to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must do. This sign means you should stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is yellow and black. It tells you a lane is ending ahead. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: This is a hand signal used by group riders to communicate. When the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger, it means all riders should form a single line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. It is diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. It tells you a traffic light is ahead. Be ready to stop for a red or yellow light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is located to your right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that you are entering a one-way street the wrong way. You could crash head-on with other traffic. Turn around safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a hand signal riders use instead of or with turn signals. When you extend your left arm straight out to the side, it means you are turning left or changing lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through this work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: A yellow "Exit only" sign means your lane will not continue through the interchange. Instead, it becomes an exit ramp. You can change lanes to continue through, or you must exit the highway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a pedestrian crossing is ahead. Be cautious and watch for pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign indicates a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep slope. Low vehicles may scrape or get caught on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs control traffic and display rules you must follow. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: This sign indicates the right lane will end ahead. Traffic in the right lane must merge left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals are important for communication when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. They are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you of a T intersection ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.
